title: Connect to
caption: Only interact with dApps you trust! Please confirm it's the correct URL and that it's secure (HTTPS).

noAccount.title: No dApp account set
noAccount.caption: You don't have a dApp account set up in $t(common:appName). Switch to the full-size $t(common:appName) app and create or import a wallet.

disabled.title: Dapp connections disabled
disabled.caption: You're currently not allowing any dapp connections. Click the button below to enable them.

cip30.title: DApp Connector (CIP30)
cip30.caption: Allows reading your balance and asking you to sign transactions. You'll be able to review a transaction before signing.

cip104.title: Account Public Key (CIP104)
cip104.caption: Allows exporting your account public key. Please note that this lets the DApp derive any address for the connected account.
